blocks.content: The Claude API lets you integrate Anthropic's AI models into your applications. You can send text and image messages, and receive model-generated responses.
The API is RESTful: you make HTTP POST requests to specific endpoints with your content, and receive JSON responses with the results.

cards.title: Chatbots and assistants
cards.description: Build interactive conversations with message history

cards.title: Content processing
cards.description: Analyze, summarize, translate, or transform text

cards.title: Data extraction
cards.description: Extract structured information from unstructured documents

cards.title: Tool use
cards.description: Let the model call functions to solve complex problems

blocks.title: Important
blocks.content: Claude Code is a CLI/IDE tool that helps you develop software. The Claude API is a remote service you can call from your code. They are complementary but different things.

steps.title: Create an account or sign in
Navigate to API Keys
steps.description: In the menu, select 'API Keys' or 'Workspaces'

steps.title: Create a new key
steps.description: Click 'Create Key' and copy it immediately

blocks.content: The key is shown only once. Store it somewhere safe.
Pass the key in the `x-api-key` header of every request:

blocks.title: Never expose your API key
blocks.content: Store keys in environment variables (.env) and never commit them to Git. If you accidentally expose a key, revoke it immediately at console.anthropic.com
